items.headline: Amber alert for lightning and heavy rain in 19 districts
items.summary: The Met Department issued an Amber warning at 1:38 PM for severe lightning and heavy rain across 19 districts, valid until 11:30 PM tonight. Flash floods, landslides and power cuts are possible, and fishermen are told to return to shore early.

items.headline: 43 Red Notice suspects traced in 17 countries
items.summary: Public Security Minister Ananda Wijepala told Parliament that 43 organised-crime suspects under Interpol Red Notices, 17 of them in Dubai, will be brought back as soon as possible. He also backed amending the drugs ordinance to allow longer detention for questioning.

items.headline: Tri-forces to be restructured by 2031
items.summary: Deputy Minister Aruna Jayasekera told Parliament the Army, Navy and Air Force will be reshaped into modern professional forces by 2031. Funds have been set aside for five anti-drone systems, and a review committee of retired commanders will be formed.

items.headline: Fuel station owners back November 30 union action
items.summary: The Petroleum Distributors Association says it supports Monday's nationwide trade union action, citing discount cuts, VAT disputes and short supply to private stations. It meets in Colombo tomorrow morning to decide its next step.

items.headline: Teen gets heart transplant at National Hospital
items.summary: A 14-year-old boy received the heart of a 19-year-old brain-dead donor from Gampaha at Colombo National Hospital and is reported to be doing well. Police escorted the organ by road after bad weather grounded the planned helicopter.

items.headline: Police to get electric vehicles, body cameras
items.summary: Minister Wijepala said police will receive 400 electric cars and 65,000 electric motorcycles in 2027, along with CCTV for 389 more stations and new uniforms fitted with body cameras.

items.headline: Foreign Minister joins IORA call with Modi
items.summary: Foreign Minister Vijitha Herath took part in a meeting with Indian PM Narendra Modi alongside other IORA ministers in New Delhi.

items.headline: President opens World Fellowship of Buddhists anniversary
items.summary: President Dissanayake attended the opening of the 60th anniversary events in Kelaniya and spoke about the role of ethical leadership in national stability.

items.headline: Port Access Expressway limited to permit holders from Dec 1
items.summary: The RDA will allow only vehicles authorised to enter Colombo Port on the Port Access Expressway from Monday. Separately, expressway revenue has passed Rs. 27.5 billion over 22 months.

items.headline: East Container Terminal nears full operations
items.summary: Ten yard lanes at Colombo Port's East Container Terminal are due to go commercial by the end of December to ease congestion, with one lane already running automated.

items.headline: CSE ends week lower
items.summary: The ASPI lost 0.8% over the week, dragged by Commercial Bank, Singer and LOLC, on average daily turnover of about Rs. 1.65 billion.

items.headline: Suspect shot in Eheliyagoda police scuffle
items.summary: A 25-year-old suspect from the van police fired on was shot in the shoulder after allegedly trying to grab an officer's gun. He is in Eheliyagoda Hospital and another suspect escaped.

items.headline: Five Chinese nationals wanted by Beijing deported
items.summary: Immigration officers deported five Chinese citizens wanted in China who were staying in Sri Lanka illegally, flying them to Shanghai and Chengdu.

items.headline: Passenger killed as rock hits bus in Ginigathhena
items.summary: A rock rolled onto an SLTB bus from Hatton to Colombo near Kalugala, killing a 35-year-old passenger. Police blame recent heavy rain.

items.headline: Small oil spill in Trincomalee Harbour
items.summary: The Coast Guard is cleaning up a slick of about 7m by 2m found in the Boom Cove area this morning.

items.headline: Sri Lanka A beat India A to reach Rising Stars final
items.summary: Openers Lasith Croospulle and Sineth Jayawardena both made centuries as Sri Lanka A chased 318 to win by eight wickets in Doha.

items.headline: Eight killed in Peru military helicopter crash
items.summary: A Peruvian military helicopter crash left eight people dead.

items.headline: FIFA says cyberattack reached limited data
items.summary: FIFA said a cyberattack against it accessed only a limited set of data.
